title: v1.1.0 – Guard-Aware Reproducibility Release (IST Revision): FSM-Bench-20
description: IST revision public replication package for FSM-Bench-20. Includes the dataset, prompt specification, schema, evaluator, conservative guard-aware determinism (M0–M3), criterion freeze, unit tests, campaign manifests, aggregate metrics summaries, and per-group diagnostics for all 106 conflict groups (manifest 20260602T195520Z). Full per-pair CSV records and raw/cleaned model outputs are size-excluded from the public archive.
